terminals.name: cs2-server
terminals.command: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q '^s2script-cs2$'; then sudo docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f cs2; else echo 'live CS2 gate not active (npm-only environment) — see AGENTS.md'; fi
terminals.description: Live CS2 dedicated server log. Boot lines '[plugins] @s2script/... Active' confirm s2script loaded. Drive it with: python3 scripts/rcon.py "meta list"
